tasks.title: merge_sorted
tasks.objective:
Write only Python: def merge_sorted(a,b):
    i=j=0; out=[]
    while i<len(a) and j<len(b):
        if a[i]<=b[j]: out.append(a[i]); i+=1
        else: out.append(b[j]); j+=1
    out.extend(a[i:]); out.extend(b[j:]); return out
assert merge_sorted([1,3],[2])==[1,2,3]
print(merge_sorted([1,3],[2,4]))

tasks.title: group_by_len
tasks.objective:
Write only Python: def group_by_len(words):
    d={}
    for w in words:
        d.setdefault(len(w), []).append(w)
    return d
assert 1 in group_by_len(['a','bb'])
print(group_by_len(['a','bb','c']))

tasks.title: levenshtein
tasks.objective:
Write only Python: def levenshtein(a,b):
    dp=list(range(len(b)+1))
    for i,ca in enumerate(a,1):
        prev=dp[:]; dp[0]=i
        for j,cb in enumerate(b,1):
            dp[j]=min(prev[j]+1, dp[j-1]+1, prev[j-1]+(ca!=cb))
    return dp[-1]
assert levenshtein('kitten','sitting')==3
print(levenshtein('kitten','sitting'))
